header.one_liner: IAI is an Israel-based aerospace and defence OEM with multiple UAVs documented in Indian service.

what_it_is.prose: IAI's Searcher Mk II and Heron families have documented Indian service. PIB records the Indian Navy operating Heron and Searcher Mk II through INAS 342, while the live UAS directory links IAI's company and platform records.

deployments_procurement.summary: IAI's Searcher Mk II and Heron families have documented Indian service. PIB records the Indian Navy operating Heron and Searcher Mk II through INAS 342, while the live UAS directory links IAI's company and platform records.

import_dependencies.summary: No indigenous percentage or component import share is asserted without direct disclosure.

dimensions.label: Critical component sovereignty
dimensions.note: Active seeker indigenous; FPGA/GaN imported; propellant indigenous

dimensions.label: Export potential
dimensions.note: Armenia reported as Akash Mk-I export customer 2025; Akash-NG export potential not yet articulated

faq.question: Which IAI UAVs are documented in India?
faq.answer: Heron and Searcher Mk II are directly documented in Indian Navy service.

faq.question: Why is it relevant to India's UAS industrial map?
faq.answer: Its UAVs are in Indian service and create an imported-platform industrial footprint.
